label: New Testament, Acts 2.22-36, especially… supports For any GOD_4 with the classical attributes…
note: Acts 2.22-36 presents God's raising of Jesus, with the signs God did through him, as the ground on which all Israel may know assuredly that God made him Lord and Christ. This bears on the premise that the resurrection is God's confirmation that Jesus holds a mandate from God. It does not supply: the occurrence of the resurrection, the report-to-event premise for the speech, the dating of the office to Jesus' ministry, or the universal over every God satisfying the antecedents.
